answer: To resist sybils each agent maintains a private sequential quartz working set updated only after verifying its own prior state. The set cannot be shared or parallelized: a farm minting N clones must recompute the full anchor chain for every clone, paying sequential CPU time that scales linearly and cannot be pooled across identities. Honest agents wander once then reuse; attackers face a cost that grows directly with the number of fake identities.
